DEFINE INSTRUMENT ESS_TOF_Spectrometer(
    double Lmin = 4.9,
    double Lmax = 5.1,
    double lambda0 = 5.0,
    double Pulse_width = 0.002857,
    int Num_pulses = 1,
    double GUI_start = 2.0,
    double FO1_DIST = 6.0,
    double L_ballistic_begin = 19.5,
    double L_ballistic_end = 17.0,
    double Length = 100.0,
    double SAMPLE_DIST = 1.2,
    double DETECTOR_DIST = 4.0,
    double GUI_h = 0.105,
    double GUI_w = 0.1,
    double GUI_GAP = 0.05,
    double H1 = 0.167,
    double W1 = 0.116,
    double H2 = 0.185,
    double W2 = 0.15,
    double H3 = 0.19,
    double W3 = 0.15,
    double H4 = 0.213,
    double W4 = 0.14,
    double H_chop = 0.075,
    double W_chop = 0.03,
    double H_end = 0.042,
    double W_end = 0.0215,
    double ALPHA = 3.4,
    double M = 3.5,
    double F_slow1 = 16.6667,
    double F_slow2 = 0.0,
    double F_fast1 = 0.0,
    double F_fast2 = 200.0,
    int N_fast = 1,
    double SLOW1_THETA = 120.0,
    double FO3 = 1.0,
    double THETA_fast1 = 180.0,
    double FAST_THETA = 5.0,
    double Gamma = 0.0,
    double Etun = 1.0,
    double V_HOLE = 0.0,
    double FRAC_QUASIEL = 0.0,
    double FRAC_TUNNEL = 0.0,
    double TT = 50.0,
    double RES_DE = 0.5,
    double cold = 0.95
)

DECLARE
%{
double FREQ;
double t_offset;
double t_FO1;
double t_FO2;
double t_fast1;
double t_fast2;
double t_fast2a;
double t_fast3;
double t_sample;
double t_detector;
double tmin_zoom;
double tmax_zoom;
double E_target;
%}

INITIALIZE
%{
FREQ = ESS_SOURCE_FREQUENCY;
t_offset = Pulse_width / 2.0 + 170e-6;
t_FO1 = FO1_DIST * lambda0 / (2 * M_PI * K2V) + t_offset;
t_FO2 = Length / 2 * lambda0 / (2 * M_PI * K2V) + t_offset;
t_fast1 = (Length / 2 + 0.1) * lambda0 / (2 * M_PI * K2V) + t_offset;
t_fast2 = Length * lambda0 / (2 * M_PI * K2V) + t_offset;
t_fast2a = (Length + GUI_GAP) * lambda0 / (2 * M_PI * K2V) + t_offset;
t_fast3 = (Length + 2 * GUI_GAP) * lambda0 / (2 * M_PI * K2V) + t_offset;
t_sample = (Length + SAMPLE_DIST) * lambda0 / (2 * M_PI * K2V) + t_offset;
t_detector = (Length + SAMPLE_DIST + DETECTOR_DIST) * lambda0 / (2 * M_PI * K2V) + t_offset;
tmin_zoom = t_fast2 * 1e6 - 1e3;
tmax_zoom = t_fast2 * 1e6 + 1e3;
E_target = VS2E * (K2V * 2 * M_PI / lambda0) * (K2V * 2 * M_PI / lambda0);
%}

TRACE

COMPONENT source = ESS_butterfly(
    sector="W", beamline=5, cold_frac=cold, target_index=6,
    dist=GUI_start, focus_xw=GUI_w, focus_yh=GUI_h,
    Lmin=Lmin, Lmax=Lmax, n_pulses=Num_pulses
)
AT (0, 0, -0.1) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Origin = Progress_bar()
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT TOFmoderator_zoom = TOF_monitor(
    nt=1000, filename="TOFmoderator_zoom.dat", xwidth=0.12, yheight=0.12,
    tmin=0, tmax=5000, restore_neutron=1
)
AT (0, 0, 1E-6) RELATIVE Origin ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT TOFmoderator = TOF_monitor(
    nt=1000, filename="TOFmoderator.dat", xwidth=0.12, yheight=0.12,
    tmin=0, tmax=3.0e5, restore_neutron=1
)
AT (0, 0, 1E-6) RELATIVE Origin ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Lmon_guistart = L_monitor(
    nL=1000, filename="Lmon_guistart.dat", xwidth=GUI_w+0.01, yheight=GUI_h+0.01,
    Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax+1
)
AT (0, 0, GUI_start-2e-6) RELATIVE Origin ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Lmon_normalize = L_monitor(
    nL=2880, filename="Lmon_guistart_normalize.dat", xwidth=0.10, yheight=0.10,
    Lmin=0, Lmax=20
)
AT (0, 0, GUI_start-1e-6) RELATIVE Origin ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Guide1 = Guide(
    w1=GUI_w, h1=GUI_h, w2=W1, h2=H1,
    l=FO1_DIST-GUI_start-GUI_GAP/2, R0=1, alpha=ALPHA, m=M, W=0.003
)
AT (0, 0, GUI_start) RELATIVE Origin ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Lmonslow1 = L_monitor(
    nL=200, filename="Lmonslow1.dat", xwidth=0.06, yheight=0.21,
    Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax+1
)
AT (0, 0, FO1_DIST-2e-6) RELATIVE Origin ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT PSDslow1 = PSD_monitor(
    filename="PSDslow1.dat", xwidth=0.1, yheight=0.25
)
AT (0, 0, FO1_DIST-1e-6) RELATIVE Origin ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT FOchop1 = DiskChopper(
    theta_0=SLOW1_THETA, radius=0.6, yheight=0.20, nu=F_slow1, nslit=1, delay=t_FO1
)
AT (0, 0, FO1_DIST) RELATIVE Origin ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT TOFLmon1 = TOFLambda_monitor(
    nL=200, nt=200, tmin=0, tmax=3e5, filename="TOFLmon1.dat",
    xwidth=0.05, yheight=0.21, Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax+1
)
AT (0, 0, 1e-6) RELATIVE FOchop1 ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Lmon_afterslow1 = L_monitor(
    nL=200, filename="Lmon_afterslow1.dat", xwidth=0.06, yheight=0.21,
    Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax+1
)
AT (0, 0, 2e-6) RELATIVE FOchop1 ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT PSD_afterslow1 = PSD_monitor(
    filename="PSD_afterslow1.dat", xwidth=0.1, yheight=0.25
)
AT (0, 0, 3e-6) RELATIVE FOchop1 ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Guidelong1 = Guide(
    w1=W1, h1=H1, w2=W2, h2=H2,
    l=L_ballistic_begin+GUI_start-FO1_DIST-GUI_GAP/2, R0=1, alpha=ALPHA, m=M, W=0.003
)
AT (0, 0, GUI_GAP/2) RELATIVE FOchop1 ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Guidelong1b = Guide(
    w1=W2, h1=H2, w2=W3, h2=H3,
    l=Length/2-L_ballistic_begin-GUI_start-GUI_GAP/2, R0=1, alpha=ALPHA, m=M, W=0.003
)
AT (0, 0, L_ballistic_begin+GUI_start) RELATIVE Origin ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Lmon_slow2 = L_monitor(
    nL=200, filename="Lmon_slow2.dat", xwidth=0.06, yheight=0.21,
    Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax+1
)
AT (0, 0, Length/2-1e-6) RELATIVE Origin ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT FOchop2 = DiskChopper(
    theta_0=155, radius=0.6, yheight=0.6, nu=F_slow2, nslit=1, delay=t_FO2
)
AT (0, 0.1, Length/2) RELATIVE Origin ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Fastchop1 = DiskChopper(
    theta_0=THETA_fast1, radius=0.5, yheight=0.5, nu=F_fast1, nslit=N_fast, delay=t_fast1
)
AT (0, 0.1, Length/2+GUI_GAP) RELATIVE Origin ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT PSD_afterslow2 = PSD_monitor(
    filename="PSD_afterslow2.dat", xwidth=0.1, yheight=0.25
)
AT (0, -0.1, 1e-6) RELATIVE Fastchop1 ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Lmon_afterslow2 = L_monitor(
    nL=200, filename="Lmon_afterslow2.dat", xwidth=0.06, yheight=0.21,
    Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax+1
)
AT (0, 0, 1e-6) RELATIVE PSD_afterslow2 ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT TOFL_afterslow2 = TOFLambda_monitor(
    nL=200, nt=200, tmin=0, tmax=3.0e5, filename="TOFL_afterslow2.dat",
    xwidth=0.05, yheight=0.21, Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax+1
)
AT (0, 0, 1e-6) RELATIVE Lmon_afterslow2 ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Guidelong2 = Guide(
    w1=W3, h1=H3, w2=W4, h2=H4,
    l=Length/2-2*GUI_GAP-L_ballistic_end, R0=1, alpha=ALPHA, m=M, W=0.003
)
AT (0, -0.1, GUI_GAP/2) RELATIVE Fastchop1 ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Lmon_beforeballistic = L_monitor(
    nL=200, filename="Lmon_before_ballistic.dat", xwidth=0.06, yheight=0.18,
    Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax+1
)
AT (0, 0, Length/2-2*GUI_GAP-L_ballistic_end+1e-6) RELATIVE Guidelong2 ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT PSD_beforeballistic = PSD_monitor(
    filename="PSD_beforeballistic.dat", xwidth=0.1, yheight=0.25
)
AT (0, 0, 1e-6) RELATIVE Lmon_beforeballistic ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Guidelong2a = Guide(
    w1=W4, h1=H4, w2=W_chop, h2=H_chop,
    l=L_ballistic_end, R0=1, alpha=ALPHA, m=M, W=0.003
)
AT (0, 0, 1e-6) RELATIVE PSD_beforeballistic ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Lmonfast2 = L_monitor(
    nL=200, filename="Lmonfast2.dat", xwidth=0.06, yheight=0.18,
    Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax+1
)
AT (0, 0, L_ballistic_end+1e-6) RELATIVE Guidelong2a ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Lmonfast2_zoom = L_monitor(
    nL=200, filename="Lmonfast2_zoom.dat", xwidth=0.06, yheight=0.18,
    Lmin=lambda0-0.2, Lmax=lambda0+0.2
)
AT (0, 0, 1e-6) RELATIVE Lmonfast2 ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT TOFLfast2 = TOFLambda_monitor(
    nL=200, nt=200, tmin=0, tmax=3.0e5, filename="TOFLfast2.dat",
    xwidth=0.05, yheight=0.12, Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax+1
)
AT (0, 0, 1e-6) RELATIVE Lmonfast2_zoom ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT TOFLfast2zoom = TOFLambda_monitor(
    nL=200, nt=200, tmin=tmin_zoom, tmax=tmax_zoom, filename="TOFLfast2_zoom.dat",
    xwidth=0.05, yheight=0.12, Lmin=lambda0-0.2, Lmax=lambda0+0.2
)
AT (0, 0, 1e-6) RELATIVE TOFLfast2 ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT PSDfast2 = PSD_monitor(
    filename="PSDfast2.dat", xwidth=0.1, yheight=0.25
)
AT (0, 0, 1e-6) RELATIVE TOFLfast2zoom ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Fastchop2 = DiskChopper(
    theta_0=FAST_THETA, radius=0.35, yheight=0.35, nu=F_fast2, nslit=N_fast, delay=t_fast2
)
AT (0, 0.04, Length) RELATIVE Origin ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Fastchop2counter = DiskChopper(
    theta_0=FAST_THETA, radius=0.35, yheight=0.35, nu=-F_fast2, nslit=N_fast, delay=-t_fast2a
)
AT (0, 0.04, Length+GUI_GAP) RELATIVE Origin ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT FOchop3 = DiskChopper(
    theta_0=2*FAST_THETA, radius=0.35, yheight=0.35, nu=F_fast2/FO3, nslit=N_fast, delay=t_fast3
)
AT (0, 0.04, Length+2*GUI_GAP) RELATIVE Origin ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT TOFfast2_zoom = TOF_monitor(
    nt=100, filename="TOF_fast2.dat", xwidth=1.1, yheight=1.2,
    tmin=1e6*t_fast3-2e2, tmax=1e6*t_fast3+2e2
)
AT (0, -0.04, 1e-6) RELATIVE FOchop3 ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Lmon_afterfast2 = L_monitor(
    nL=500, filename="Lmon_afterfast2.dat", xwidth=0.06, yheight=0.18,
    Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax+1
)
AT (0, 0, 1e-6) RELATIVE TOFfast2_zoom ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT TOFL_afterfast2 = TOFLambda_monitor(
    nL=200, nt=200, tmin=0, tmax=3.0e5, filename="TOF_afterfast2.dat",
    xwidth=0.05, yheight=0.12, Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax+1
)
AT (0, 0, 1e-6) RELATIVE Lmon_afterfast2 ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT TOFL_afterfast2_zoom = TOFLambda_monitor(
    nL=200, nt=200, tmin=tmin_zoom, tmax=tmax_zoom, filename="TOFL_afterfast2_zoom.dat",
    xwidth=0.05, yheight=0.12, Lmin=lambda0-0.2, Lmax=lambda0+0.2
)
AT (0, 0, 1e-6) RELATIVE TOFL_afterfast2 ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT PSD_afterfast2 = PSD_monitor(
    filename="PSD_afterfast2.dat", xwidth=0.1, yheight=0.25
)
AT (0, 0, 1e-6) RELATIVE TOFL_afterfast2_zoom ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Guidesample = Guide(
    w1=W_chop, h1=H_chop, w2=W_end, h2=H_end,
    l=SAMPLE_DIST-4*GUI_GAP, R0=1, alpha=ALPHA, m=M, W=0.003
)
AT (0, 0, GUI_GAP/2) RELATIVE PSD_afterfast2 ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Lmon_guideend = L_monitor(
    nL=1000, filename="Lmon_guideend.dat", xwidth=W_end+0.01, yheight=H_end+0.01,
    Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax+1
)
AT (0, 0, SAMPLE_DIST-4*GUI_GAP+1e-6) RELATIVE Guidesample ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT PSDsample = PSD_monitor(
    filename="PSDsample.dat", xwidth=0.1, yheight=0.25
)
AT (0, 0, SAMPLE_DIST-3*GUI_GAP+1e-6) RELATIVE Lmon_guideend ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT TOFsample_zoom = TOF_monitor(
    nt=500, filename="TOF_sample.dat", xwidth=0.02, yheight=0.04,
    tmin=1e6*t_sample-5e4, tmax=1e6*t_sample+5e4
)
AT (0, 0, 1e-6) RELATIVE PSDsample ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Esample = E_monitor(
    nE=400, filename="Esample", xwidth=0.02, yheight=0.04,
    Emin=E_target-RES_DE, Emax=E_target+RES_DE
)
AT (0, 0, 1e-6) RELATIVE TOFsample_zoom ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Lmon_sample_zoom = L_monitor(
    nL=100, filename="LMON_sample_zoom.dat", xwidth=0.02, yheight=0.04,
    Lmin=lambda0-0.1, Lmax=lambda0+0.1
)
AT (0, 0, 1e-6) RELATIVE Esample ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT sample = Tunneling_sample(
    thickness=0.01-V_HOLE, radius=0.01, p_interact=1,
    f_QE=FRAC_QUASIEL, f_tun=FRAC_TUNNEL, gamma=Gamma, E_tun=Etun,
    focus_xw=0.015, focus_yh=0.015, yheight=0.04, target_index=2
)
AT (0, -0.04, SAMPLE_DIST) RELATIVE Fastchop2 ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT detectorarm = Arm()
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE sample ROTATED (0, TT, 0) RELATIVE sample

COMPONENT TOFdetector = TOF_monitor(
    nt=512, filename="TOF.dat", xwidth=0.015, yheight=0.015,
    tmin=0, tmax=2e5
)
AT (0, 0, DETECTOR_DIST) RELATIVE detectorarm ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT TOFdetector_zoom = TOF_monitor(
    nt=100, filename="TOF_zoom.dat", xwidth=0.015, yheight=0.015,
    tmin=1e6*t_detector-10e2, tmax=1e6*t_detector+10e2
)
AT (0, 0, 1e-6) RELATIVE TOFdetector ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Edetector = E_monitor(
    nE=400, filename="Edet", xwidth=0.015, yheight=0.015,
    Emin=E_target-RES_DE, Emax=E_target+RES_DE
)
AT (0, 0, 1e-6) RELATIVE TOFdetector_zoom ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT TOF2Edetector = TOF2E_monitor(
    nE=200, filename="TOF2E.dat", xwidth=0.015, yheight=0.015,
    Emin=E_target-RES_DE, Emax=E_target+RES_DE, T_zero=t_sample, L_flight=DETECTOR_DIST
)
AT (0, 0, 1e-6) RELATIVE Edetector ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

END
